name: auth
title: Auth
description: Primitives for signing in and joining a workspace: a full-page frame with one narrow centred column, the icon over a page's title, a one-time code input with a box per digit that handles paste, autofill and Backspace, a password input you can show, a password strength meter with the rules it still needs, a row of sign-in providers, a send-again button that counts down, the row at the bottom that leads to another way in, Google, X and GitHub logos, a square workspace avatar with a logo, a mark or initials, and an email masking helper.
